assessment.reading: Interpret sophisticated economic, financial and policy texts with precision, nuance and source awareness.

assessment.writing: Produce executive briefs, analytical arguments and evidence-based recommendations with strong cohesion.
assessment.decisionMaking: Evaluate competing economic scenarios, risks, trade-offs and constraints before recommending action.
assessment.presentation: Communicate complex financial and economic evidence clearly to expert and non-expert audiences.
